description: Hand-annotated relevance judgements. A chunk (budget component) is relevant if a developer estimating the query project would reuse it as a precedent. Judged against the full text of the 24 components in data/budgets_sample.json.

queries.query: Online store with a searchable product catalog, shopping cart checkout with card payments and a customer loyalty points program
queries.notes: Payments distractors: BUD-2024-014::PAY-002 (instant bank transfers) and BUD-2023-087::BILL-004 (Stripe invoicing) are payment-related but not e-commerce.

queries.query: Mobile banking app where customers log in with biometrics, freeze their cards and send instant transfers
queries.notes: Whole fintech budget is a precedent. Other auth components (AUTH-004 JWT, SSO-004 SAML) are distractors.

queries.query: Telehealth platform for private clinics: doctors publish availability, patients book appointments with reminders and attend video consultations
queries.notes: EHR-003 and BILL-004 are in the same budget but the query does not ask for records or billing.

queries.query: Authentication service issuing JWT tokens with role-based authorization for dispatchers, drivers and administrators
queries.notes: Exact-term query (JWT, roles). AUTH-001 covers tokens/refresh in a banking context; EHR-003 has role-based access but for patient records.

queries.query: Insurance claims system that extracts data from uploaded invoices and police reports and automatically routes claims to adjusters by fraud risk
queries.notes: NOTIF-004 (customer notifications) is in the same budget but not requested.
